summary: Make GateContext.stateRootRel a required key carrying string | undefined, as its two sibling contexts already spell it, and drop its false back-compat narration

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

tests: GateContext.stateRootRel is required, so a gate context omitting it is a type error
acceptance: tsc and vitest green with stateRootRel a required key, every hand-built GateContext stating it, and the doc comment naming relocation rather than fixture compat
notes: src/Gate.ts:68 claims the optionality exists so fixtures predating the field keep compiling — a back-compat shim spec-plan-build.md (*Pre-1.0 clean-slate posture*) forbids, and not the real reason: absence means a relocated state root (spec/chain.md, *What a gate receives*). Siblings src/worktrees.ts:61 and src/friction.ts:117 already spell the same field required-with-undefined. commitSha? and baseSha? carry the same fixture rationale but spec ratifies theirs — open question, not this entry.
